verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control. The opt-in webhook signing setting is an unrelated security control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
